purpose: Maps each production agent to the RAG evidence sources it should retrieve before producing or reviewing a risk claim.
priority_order: Project numeric data from Silver/Gold tables
Curated financial terms and thresholds from data/rag/financial_terms.jsonl
Model output from fine-tuned or remote LLM agents
General narrative context from retrieved documents

financial_terms.description: Curated financial definitions, threshold rules, and policy guidance.

fundamental_silver.description: SEC-derived company fundamentals, cash, debt, income, assets, liabilities, and equity.

market_silver.description: Yahoo Finance price, volatility, beta, drawdown, valuation, and market features.

sentiment_silver.description: Filtered NewsAPI/Google News headline sentiment aggregates by ticker and date.

raw_news.description: Raw headline-level news records retained for audit and reprocessing.

gold_risk.description: Project Gold layer with final engineered risk features and labels.

runtime_vector_store.description: Generated Chroma vector store. Rebuildable artifact, not source-of-truth data.

fundamental_agent.query_template: {ticker} cash debt income revenue equity profitability margin leverage
fundamental_agent.output_use: Ground FinBERT or fallback fundamental classifications in SEC-derived evidence and financial ratio thresholds.

market_agent.query_template: {ticker} annualized volatility beta drawdown price versus 52-week high return trend
market_agent.output_use: Ground market LoRA or fallback outputs in Yahoo-derived price and volatility features only.

sentiment_agent.query_template: {ticker} recent financial headlines positive neutral negative sentiment confidence
sentiment_agent.output_use: Ground ProsusAI/FinBERT headline sentiment in filtered recent news and disclose thin or missing coverage.

critic_agent.query_template: {ticker} evidence priority confidence disagreement policy fallback review
critic_agent.output_use: Verify specialist claims, detect contradictions, disclose fallback behavior, and produce an auditable final verdict.
